name: ci-spatial-scan-mobile-shell
description: Scan native iOS + Android shell (Capacitor 8). SCAFFOLD, NOT FOR STORE SUBMISSION. Standalone npm project, deliberately NOT a root workspace: it ships the PWA-off web build from www/ via webDir and never imports the web code.

scripts.build:web: cd .. && npx tsc --noEmit && VITE_DISABLE_PWA=1 npx vite build --outDir mobile/www --emptyOutDir
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run sync
